text:
Mira (Docs): Heads-up — opened a hotfix PR to patch docs after yesterday's outage. Fixes: status page link, add known-issues section, and a short workaround note for SDK users. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
Sam (Eng): Thanks — can you paste the status page URL? Also, should we merge before the next deploy window or wait for the scheduled release?
Mira (Docs): Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-14 — that's the authoritative link. My preference is merge ASAP if CI/docs preview is green; we want customers to have the correct link. Target: within the hour. Workaround snippet is in the PR below.
Tyler (Eng): CI preview is erroring: preview site returned 404 for /known-issues. Looks like the nav entry didn't make it into the TOC. I'll take a quick pass to add it.
ci-bot: Netlify preview failed for branch hotfix/docs-482 — build error: 404 on /known-issues. Logs: build step 'collect-pages' failed. https://app.netlify.com/sites/docs-preview/deploys/1234567890
Sasha (Support): Can we make the workaround copy customer-friendly? Need a one-liner for replies and a slightly longer paragraph we can paste into support threads.
Mira (Docs): Proposed one-liner: "Temporary workaround: use the stable embeddings endpoint and set client-side cache TTL to 60s." Longer note included in PR. Also adding an explicit code example for SDK users: 
```python
# quick retry workaround for SDK users
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate("Summarize the transcript", max_tokens=200, retry=3)
```
Tyler (Eng): Added TOC/nav fix and adjusted the wording on the one-liner. Pushed new commit (7f9cb2) to hotfix/docs-482.
ci-bot: Netlify preview succeeded for branch hotfix/docs-482 — preview: https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.ai/known-issues
Sam (Eng): Reviewing now. Quick scan looks good; link goes to the status page as expected. :thumbsup:
Mira (Docs): @Sam @Tyler — can one of you approve the PR? We need one more approval to satisfy branch protection and bypass the 30-min merge window.
Tyler (Eng): Approved. :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: PR #482 merged into main by Mira (Docs). Docs site will include changes in the next publication job. Action items: backport to release-v1.2 branch, add the status link to the incident postmortem, and update the support playbook with the one-liner.
Sasha (Support): I'll add the copy to the postmortem and ping Mira for sign-off on wording.
Mira (Docs): Thanks everyone — I'll create the backport PR and drop the postmortem copy into the incident doc.
Sam (Eng): Good move. Also suggest we add a short test to CI that checks the /known-issues page doesn't 404 (small integration smoke).
Mira (Docs): Added issue to the docs backlog: "smoke test for known-issues route". Will follow up with a tiny CI job next sprint.
Tyler (Eng): Nice. Closing loop on this thread.
